name: BibliographicCatalogueEntries
description: Library catalogues, bibliographies and book lists with one entry per described publication.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no bibliographic entries. Otherwise, set to false.

author.description: The author as given in the entry, surname first where printed so. Use null for anonymous works.

title.description: The title of the work, as written in the entry.

place.description: The place of publication. Use null if not stated.

publisher.description: The publisher or printer. Use null if not stated.

year.description: The year of publication as written. Example: '1745' or '1745?'. Use null if not stated.

format.description: The physical format or size. Example: 'octavo' or '12mo'. Use null if not stated.

source_page.description: The page on which the entry appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks in the entry, such as editions, pagination or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
